report:
Reassessed the complete validated_session claim and both implementation entries plus all five associated tests. Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of both historical implementation files and all four historical test files; also verified unchanged SalsaObserver and fixture-test context. This supports comparison with the supplied prior review, not substitution for current assessment.
Source: ContractModel owns resolved operations behind a private map with immutable access; new rejects validation diagnostics before constructing it. ContractSession retains one Arc and every request/prohibition lookup uses that model. Separate session state and observer-local immutable index/verified-source mappings permit independently configured models without mutating an active session. repeated_roots_are_independent_and_models_are_shared_immutably meaningfully asserts a conforming first session and two violations in an independent second session using the shared model. invalid_static_model_never_becomes_a_runtime_contract asserts rejection of forbidden static contracts. source_snapshot_mismatch_is_rejected asserts exact source acceptance and modified/unknown-file rejection. Captured verify_source compares indexed text with compiled text; SalsaObserver checks supplied compiled snapshots at construction and fails conformance for observed unpaired sources, retaining the index and mapping for the session.
real_salsa_contract_fixture checks subprocess success and cold/prewarmed model, violations, path and coverage values in its annotated body. Captured fixture setup supplies include_str! compiled source and validated model documents; its stale-source and unpaired-source assertions supplement source/build mismatch coverage, and its reset creates independent sessions. This is manual fixture loading, not evidence of cached automatic loading or model-update discovery.
The ordinary implementation establishes the immutable runtime core. The second implementation entry and automatic_runtime_loading_is_cached_and_rejects_unavailable_models test are explicit TODO evidence, with no behavioral assertions: automatic loader implementation is the prerequisite for cached loads, parallel first use, explicit model roots, unavailable/missing-file rejection and new-session visibility of edits. These remain deferred, including full automatic invalid-file loading behavior; static-invalid-model rejection already has substantive coverage. Distinct fixture model configuration is supported by constructor ownership, while automatic reload/edit scenarios are covered by the declared deferral. No N/A entries exist and no deferred behavior is claimed implemented.
Execution: I ran review start/read and baseline comparisons, and am recording this report; I ran no behavioral tests or workspace build. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional tests and a passing root build. No requested edits; existing loader TODO remains visible.
